+## Concorde change worktree
+
+This agent session starts in a secondary worktree containing an unfinished candidate change.
+The host records its lifecycle in `.concorde/worktree.json`. `concorde-main` receives this worktree's
+identity, draft status and the primary worktree's live change inventory. Partial Spec and
+implementation edits are draft state; resume the recorded phase before claiming completion.
+
+You may invoke `concorde-deliver` from this source worktree or the destination worktree.
+The destination is the primary worktree: /home/zhenyu/concorde.
+The session's initial working directory must be one of those two participants; a third
+worktree cannot deliver this change by redirecting or forwarding its invocation.
+Delivery creates concorde/delivered/<change_id> and leaves the primary branch unchanged.
+The host removes this source unless keep_worktree:true was explicitly requested.
+End this session after removal. Only an explicit user request to the sole primary writer
+authorizes a separate merge_primary:true request from the primary session.
+Development loops stop at a ready candidate and never deliver automatically.
+<!-- concorde-change-worktree:end -->
